    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match WHERE away_player_2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match WHERE away_player_3 IS NOT NULL

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        cc.total_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        1.0 * SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,

pivot AS (

)
